newsitem.title: USA: NRC says postpones meeting with Unicom.
newsitem.headline: NRC says postpones meeting with Unicom.

text.p: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Thursday it rescheduled a meeting with Unicom Corp's Commonwealth Edison Co regarding its Quad Cities Nuclear Power Station in Cordova, Ill., until Feb 27.
The meeting was previously planned to be held Feb 19.
NRC said the meeting was postponed at the request of Commonwealth Edison to allow additional time for its staff to prepare for the meeting.
Last month, Commonwealth Edison outlined initiatives it is taking to address concerns raised by the NRC regarding operations of the utility's nuclear power plants.
Commonwealth Edison has said it will increase spending on its nuclear operations and is confident it will prove it can run its facilities safely.
